description:
Roletopia is interactive fiction you play — not random AI text. Step into hand-authored, fully narrated, fully illustrated branching stories, told in second person, where YOU are the protagonist and every choice changes where the story goes.

Each story is written and validated before it ships: real decision points, multiple paths, and 3 to 13 different endings you can actually reach. Most stories let you play as one of two or three protagonists, so the same plot feels different depending on whose life you step into.

WHAT MAKES ROLETOPIA DIFFERENT
- Authored stories, not an open-ended generator — every tale is written, narrated, and illustrated by hand
- Play as the protagonist — second-person stories where your choices matter
- Branching paths with multiple endings — 3 to 13 written endings per story
- AI co-stars on many stories — roleplay by text, or by voice with a subscription, with the other lead in character and the plot as shared context
- Narration audio and a unique illustration in every scene
- Genres for every mood: romance, drama, mystery, thriller, fantasy, sci-fi, and adventure

NEW — NOW GLOBAL
- The app interface now speaks 18 languages, with a new in-app picker
- AI chat and voice reply in whatever language you type or speak
- Story text is in English — and the first stories are now arriving in Spanish and Hindi
- Refreshed artwork across the catalog — beautiful new illustrations

VOICE CHAT WITH YOUR CO-STAR
On stories that have a co-star, talk out loud and they answer back in character, turn by turn — the story you are both inside is the shared context. It turns reading into a conversation. (Voice chat is available with a subscription.)

FREE TO START — HONEST TOKENS
- Free to begin — you never pay to start a story
- Unlock stories with RTC tokens; chat and voice draw on a separate chat-token balance
- Earn tokens back through optional rewarded ads
- Optional Standard and Premium subscriptions; voice chat is for subscribers
- Pricing varies by region — details at roletopia.ai

MADE FOR ADULTS
Roletopia is a curated app for adults, rated 18+ — not an open-ended generator. The AI co-stars run with content safety filters, and you can report anything that does not belong. There is no ID upload or selfie check inside the app; the gate is the store's 18+ rating.

Download Roletopia and step into a story that was waiting for you.

Questions? roletopia@constagility.com
Terms: https://www.roletopia.ai/en/terms
Privacy: https://www.roletopia.ai/en/privacy
